sm.$description:
Text style for display.sm: font-family.heading and font-weight.heading.strong from the brand; size and line height from the brand's scale at the step each viewport picks (font-size.display.sm, line-height.display.sm); tracking from letter-spacing.display.sm. Varies by brand and viewport.

Used in:
Any display.sm text. Headings and display use only the strong weight, so the style has no weight segment.

Do not:
Do not invent a .default or .strong variant — display styles are bare. Do not rebuild it from the atomic tokens; bind the style, so a scale change reaches it.
